text: もぐって…　うみ　ポケモン　とろうとしたけど　だめ　みたいだ！

structure.jp: うみ　ポケモン　とろうとしたけど
structure.en: tried to catch sea Pokémon, but
it looks like it's no good!

patterns.name: 〜ようとする
patterns.explanation: The 'let's' form of a verb plus とする says someone tries to do it. とろうとした = 'I tried to catch'.

patterns.name: 〜みたいだ
patterns.explanation: みたいだ says that is how things seem. だめ　みたいだ = 'it seems to be no good'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て form joins one action to the next, like 'and'. もぐって = 'I dove and'.
